description: This file defines a small library for managing a stack of signal handlers to enable safe cleanup and chaining of signal handling routines. It includes type definitions, function prototypes for pushing, popping, and managing signal handlers, and documentation explaining the intended usage pattern.

methods.name: sigchain_push
methods.description: Pushes a signal handler onto the stack for a specific signal.

methods.name: sigchain_pop
methods.description: Removes the top handler for a specific signal.

methods.name: sigchain_push_common
methods.description: Pushes a handler onto the stack for a predefined set of common signals.

methods.name: sigchain_pop_common
methods.description: Removes the handler for the common signals.
